migration: Flyway V1-V6 from an empty isolated database
scope: BPI topology read, controlled rule replay, checksum-gated publication and transactional Kafka outbox

items.evidence: Only the seeded tenant/plant/line topology and its revision were returned.
The controlled AST, topology version, checksum and revision were returned.
Missing Idempotency-Key and If-Match returned 428 before persistence.
An empty calibrated telemetry window returned 422 and the transaction left zero idempotency rows.
Two calibrated PostgreSQL observations emitted one START boundary and matched one operator golden boundary.
Same-key replay returned the original simulation and checksum without another simulation row.
Rule was SIMULATION_PASSED|2; metrics were 1 matched, 0 missed, 0 false positive; observationCount was 2.
A mismatched simulation checksum returned 422 and rolled back.
Rule became PUBLISHED|3, one PENDING outbox event committed, and audits were RULE_SIMULATED|1|2 then RULE_PUBLISHED|2|3.
The stored BoundaryRulePublicationV1 contained scope, locality group, topology/rule identity, two conditions, two bindings and the controlled checksum.
Concurrent claims, stale recovery, bounded retry, PUBLISHED completion and terminal FAILED state were verified directly against PostgreSQL.
A marker event reached an embedded broker, the row became PUBLISHED|1, and a second poll emitted no duplicate marker.
API distinguishes NOT_PUBLISHED, PENDING, DISPATCHING, Kafka-confirmed PUBLISHED and FAILED without claiming Flink activation.
A same-tenant token without the rule line scope received 404.

verificationSql: SELECT state, revision, latest_simulation_id FROM bpi.bpi_rule_versions WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND id=:rule; SELECT state, checksum, metrics, input_manifest, emitted_boundaries FROM bpi.bpi_rule_simulations WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND rule_version_id=:rule; SELECT status,attempt_count,published_at,last_error FROM bpi.bpi_outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND aggregate_id=:rule;
cleanup: After each test, rows were deleted only for the dynamic tenant marker; the rule latest_simulation_id was cleared before deleting simulations.
limitations: Kafka broker confirmation is visible, but a Flink Broadcast State activation acknowledgment is not implemented.
Dual approval and rule/topology draft editing are not implemented.
Replay safety is capped at 100000 observations but load and soak testing remain pending.
